profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, MCPD, MCTS & IBM Certified IT Professional
profile.summary:
An energetic Full-Stack software engineer with more than 8 Years of professional IT experience in object oriented design, analysis, development & implementation of various enterprise applications using Microsoft and other open source technologies.

Specialties: C#, ASP.Net stack (Webforms, MVC, Web API), .Net Core stack, Windows Communication Foundation(WCF), Windows Presentation Foundation(WPF), XAML, VB.Net, Linq, Entity Framework, SQL Server, AngularJS, NodeJS, Microsoft Dynamics CRM, SQL Server Business Intelligence, Hybrid App, PCI DSS Developer.
